note: Run against a test workspace, or only with --dry-run. Never confirm writes against the production workspace.

evals.prompt: Was habe ich letzte Woche gebucht? Summe pro Projekt.
evals.expected_output: Runs `summary --last-week` (Monday–Sunday of the previous week) and shows the total and per-project hours as a table. No write command is run.
assertions: uses summary with --last-week or explicit --from/--to of last week

evals.prompt: Trag mir heute 9:00–11:30 auf Projekt 'Intern' ein, Beschreibung 'Weekly Planning'.
evals.expected_output: Runs `create --date <today> --start 09:00 --end 11:30 --project Intern --desc 'Weekly Planning' --dry-run`, shows a preview table (date, start, end, 2.5 h, project, task, description), and waits for an explicit 'ja' before running with --yes.
assertions: does not pass --yes before the user says ja

evals.prompt: Ändere die Beschreibung meines letzten Eintrags auf 'Kundencall Müller'.
evals.expected_output: Finds the latest entry via week/last-week, runs `update <id> --desc 'Kundencall Müller' --dry-run`, shows before/after, and waits for 'ja'. Only the description changes.
assertions: identifies the latest entry by date+start

evals.prompt: Starte einen Timer für Projekt X — und danach: stopp den Timer.
evals.expected_output: Runs `start --project X --dry-run`, confirms, then `--yes`. For stopping, runs `stop --dry-run`, confirms, then `stop --yes`, and shows the entry read back with its end time.

evals.prompt: Zeig mir meine Buchungen von heute. (Setup: CLOCKIFY_API_KEY unset)
evals.expected_output: The script exits with 2 and names CLOCKIFY_API_KEY plus how to set it. Claude relays that message without crashing, does not ask for the key in chat, and does not suggest a plaintext config file.
assertions: does not request the key in chat

evals.prompt: Buch mir 1h auf Projekt 'Kunde' für heute 14:00–15:00. (Setup: projects 'Kunde X' and 'Kunde XY' exist)
evals.expected_output: The script exits with 3 and lists both candidates. Claude asks the user which project is meant (AskUserQuestion) and does not book anything.

evals.prompt: Trag mir heute 10:00–11:00 auf 'Intern' ein. (Setup: an entry from 10:30–12:00 already exists today)
evals.expected_output: The dry-run prints an 'Überschneidung' warning naming the existing entry. Claude points out the overlap in the preview before asking for confirmation.
